# Catania Airport Transfer

> Private transfers with a chauffeur from Catania Fontanarossa Airport to Taormina, Giardini Naxos, Siracusa, Milazzo, Cefalù, Agrigento and the rest of Sicily. Fixed price for the whole vehicle, tolls and VAT included. Chauffeur by the hour also available.

Facts that apply to every transfer (prices and drive times are on each route page):
- The price is for the whole vehicle, not per person.
- With a flight number, free waiting is 60 minutes after landing. We track the flight.
- Book at least 24 hours before pickup. For less notice, write on WhatsApp.
- A booking is a request until it is paid. We reply by email with a payment link.
- The operator holds NCC licences no. 10 and 43 (Comune di Scordia), Via Badia 3, 95123 Catania, Italy.
- Contact: info@cataniaairporttransfer.net, phone and WhatsApp +39 320 052 8300.
